raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Delivery batch 13 (ingested 2026-01-18) sent merchant_id as prefixed, zero-padded strings such as 'M-0121' instead of plain integers like '121', so the INTEGER cast in silver_transactions fails. merchant_id has 80 distinct values, which fits the same 40 merchants (100–139) appearing in both formats, so 'M-0NNN' maps to merchant NNN; no change note confirms this new format.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.75, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CASE WHEN merchant_id LIKE 'M-%' THEN CAST(substr(merchant_id, 3) AS INTEGER) ELSE CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) END AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
